scripts.postinstall: npm run build:shared && npm run prepare --workspace @form-saathi/extension
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @form-saathi/api && npm run build --workspace @form-saathi/extension && npm run build:fixtures && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm run build --workspace @form-saathi/api && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && vitest run packages
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @form-saathi/api && vitest run tests
scripts.test:fixtures: npm run build:fixtures && playwright test --project practice
scripts.package:pilot: npm run build && npm run zip --workspace @form-saathi/extension
